title.narrative: Analysis Experts Roundtable Meeting on AU Mediation on Ethiopia
Crisis Action, Analysis Experts Roundtable Meeting on AU Mediation on Ethiopia

description.narrative: The overall objective of the Project is to conduct a SWOT analysis of the AU-led mediation and identify how civil society can contribute towards Ethiopias peace efforts. The specific expected output/outcomes are: - A SWOT analysis on the AU mediation is developed as a tool for future campaign work. - Civil society actors gain deeper insights into the trends, dynamics, gaps, and opportunities of the AU mediation and how these insights can be leveraged for civil society campaign efforts. - Participants harvest lessons from other peace agreements and infuse them into the campaign on Ethiopia - A CSO coalition that feels connected with a shared agenda towards campaign and advocacy work on Ethiopia - The AU mediation is strengthened through the analysis and advocacy results by the civil society campaign on Ethiopia.

sector.narrative: Civilian peace-building, conflict prevention and resolution

description.narrative: The outcomes of the AU roundtable and the recommendations document have served and continue to serve as a critical advocacy tool and anchor for ongoing and upcoming advocacy activities co-created and in collaboration with civil society organisations working on Ethiopia. The outcomes have been key in the delivery of recent advocacy activities Crisis Action has spearheaded with partners including the following: - It informed the framing and messages of a live webinar on Ethiopia that Crisis Action facilitated with partners and hosted by South Africas Daily Maverick on 16 February 2023.
